messages:
incident-bot: pager: high error rate detected for canary rollout 'my-service:v2' in us-west-2 — 5xx spike >10% over 3m, alert=ALERT-8291

maria (oncall): Oncall here. I see the same in grafana: canary latency + 5xx. Linking logs: https://logs.internal/recent?query=my-service+canary

kyle (eng-infra): I'm looking at kube events and imagepull logs. kubectl describe shows ImagePullBackOff + backoff pulling manifest errors.

sophia (release-engineer): Heads-up, I enabled the new image optimizer that emits 'sparse-layer' blobs in the last build — tag: my-service:v2+opt-ff. Might be related.

dan (sre): Registry logs show manifest resolution failures:
```
registry ERROR: GET /v2/my-service/manifests/sha256:7a2f... 404 manifest unknown
registry ERROR: GET /v2/my-service/blobs/sha256:layer-sparse-000 404 blob unknown
```

kyle (eng-infra): That matches. If the builder created sparse chunk refs the registry/proxy may be treating them as missing and some nodes fall back to older tag -> mixed manifests = inconsistent image served to canary pods.

maria (oncall): We need immediate mitigation. Can we pause the rollout and flip the feature flag? Minimal blast radius.

kyle (eng-infra): I'll pause the k8s rollout:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deploy/my-service
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/my-service-canary --replicas=0
```

sophia (release-engineer): I'm disabling the feature flag on Flags Service now (release.v2.enable -> false):
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS_TOKEN' https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"release.v2.enable","value":false}'
```

deploy-bot: rollback triggered by kyle: `/rollback canary --to-tag sha256:4f3c-oldstable`

kyle (eng-infra): Scheduled a controlled rollback and starting a rebuild without sparse-layer:
```
./ci/rebuild.sh --service my-service --no-sparse-layer --ref v2
./ci/push.sh --service my-service --tag sha256:fixed-202831
```

dan (sre): Re-push accepted by registry, manifest resolved for new tag sha256:fixed-202831. I've validated with curl to registry: `GET /v2/my-service/manifests/sha256:fixed-202831` -> 200 OK.

kyle (eng-infra): Rolling new fixed image to canary (scaled to 2 pods) and keeping rollout paused until health checks pass.

maria (oncall): Health checks passing on those canary pods — 200s now and 5xx back to baseline (~0.3%). Monitoring graphs look stable.

support-team: CS informed customers who reported errors in last 30m; described transient 500s affecting canary traffic only. No data loss.

sophia (release-engineer): Root cause hypothesis: new optimizer emitted 'sparse-layer' references that our registry proxy didn't advertise/replicate consistently, causing manifest resolve failures and fallback behavior. We'll remove sparse output until registry support is confirmed.

dan (sre): Creating incident ticket INC-2028-8291 and capturing diagnostics. We'll draft postmortem: timeline, impact, remediation (rebuild + registry fix), and long-term: registry support for sparse blobs or builder safeguard.

maria (oncall): I'll run a 15m watch. If stable, we close and hand to AM shift for postmortem. Thanks all for fast turnaround :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident recorded INC-2028-8291 — severity: sev2, owner: dan (sre). Handoff scheduled to morning rotation for postmortem and follow-ups.
